query:
-- Iowa: set status to General, update pct_reporting
UPDATE senate_races SET
  status = 'General',
  pct_reporting = 99.00
WHERE state_code = 'IA';

-- New Mexico: clarify R nominee situation, update pct_reporting
UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate2_name = 'No R nominee on ballot (write-in only)',
  pct_reporting = 95.00
WHERE state_code = 'NM';

-- New Jersey: update pct_reporting
UPDATE senate_races SET
  pct_reporting = 93.00
WHERE state_code = 'NJ';

-- South Dakota: update pct_reporting
UPDATE senate_races SET
  pct_reporting = 95.00
WHERE state_code = 'SD';
